email.subject: Family Pros Dentistry: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I checked Family Pros Dentistry's site. Two things are likely costing you new patients: it's not mobile-friendly, and there's no click-to-call button, so people searching on their phones can't easily reach you or even view the site properly before they give up and call someone else.

I also noticed heavy images slowing load times, no patient reviews shown, and a footer with outdated info.

I'm Alex, I run Northlight Web - I fix local business sites for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change. No pressure either way.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
